races.name: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
CHARLES RITZ has a patchy profile but his record fresh is hard to fault so he could be the answer in a trappy-looking contest. Last year's winner Fern Hill shaped as if needing his comeback run despite his prominence in the market so is next best.

  1. CHARLES RITZ
  2. FERN HILL (IRE)
  3. SHERBORNE (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Bet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TEORIE is surely worth another chance on his second start for this yard having dropped so far in the weights. Bread And Butter is a solid alternative.

  1. TEORIE (IRE)
  2. BREAD AND BUTTER (IRE)
  3. OCEAN HEIGHTS

races.name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Guaranteed Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SEVEN STARS showed plenty in bumpers and the 7 lb she receives from penalised-winner Dancing Dame tips the scales firmly in her favour.

  1. SEVEN STARS
  2. DANCING DAME (IRE)
  3. MARVELOUS DRAGONES (FR)

races.name: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
CAP RICOCHET has more to offer as a chaser so looks well up to completing a hat-trick. Helios Allen can make the frame again.

  1. CAP RICOCHET
  2. HELIOS ALLEN (FR)
  3. WALK THE PLANK (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp BOG From 10am Selling Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BRIGHT LEGEND is given another chance back down in trip and with a tongue strap re-fitted. Latin is the obvious threat having gone very close on his final start for Olly Murphy at Plumpton 3 weeks ago.

  1. BRIGHT LEGEND (IRE)
  2. LATIN (IRE)
  3. BLACKWATER LILLY

races.name: PricedUp Bet Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GALLIVANTED produced his best effort yet over hurdles when second over C&D 2 weeks ago and from the same mark, he could be the way to go with his stable starting to hit form. Virtual Rock and Cayman Dancer are in-form rivals, while Blues Singer may up his game this season.

  1. GALLIVANTED (FR)
  2. BLUES SINGER
  3. CAYMAN DANCER

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Open NH Flat Race (AWT) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It remains to be seen whether this sharp test will suit point winner GOT TO BE REAL but representing a leading yard, he may well get away with it. Bombus Pascuorum has to carry a penalty for winning an ordinary race last time but he can still be a factor, while this test may be much more suitable for Ezenli given his pedigree.

  1. GOT TO BE REAL (IRE)
  2. BOMBUS PASCUORUM (IRE)
  3. EZENLI (IRE)

races.name: Sharon Knapp Memorial Cup EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PORT GLEN ONE made short work of 2 rivals at Market Rasen a month ago and this point winner can extend his sequence to 3 under a penalty. Wild Wescht must have had an issue or 2 since contesting a couple of points but the market may tell a tale.

  1. PORT GLEN ONE (IRE)
  2. WILD WESCHT (IRE)
  3. TEMPLAR KNIGHT

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A case of sorts can be made for all 5 but RIDE LIKE A GIRL continued the excellent work when runner-up at Stratford 3 weeks ago and a repeat of that may well be enough. Kamille Au Kanada has an excellent strike rate and can remain very competitive in handicaps, so she's feared most.

  1. RIDE LIKE A GIRL (FR)
  2. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR)
  3. REEL ORANGE (IRE)

races.name: Careersinracing Step On Track Programme Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not a convincing bunch so it's perhaps worth siding with WESTERN SOLDIER, who lurks on a very dangerous mark and offered a bit more at Fontwell 4 weeks ago. Zaraquelle will doubtless be popular, while Diamond Days can get back on track returned to hurdling.

  1. WESTERN SOLDIER (GER)
  2. ZARAQUELLE (FR)
  3. DIAMOND DAYS (IRE)

races.name: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SAILING BY is one of the least exposed and shaped as if this increase in trip was worth exploring when third at Fontwell 3 weeks ago. He could be worth siding with from a further reduced mark with his yard continuing in excellent form. Huntingdon scorer Cinnodin might be the danger.

  1. SAILING BY (IRE)
  2. CINNODIN
  3. BETTY'S TIARA

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SPIKE JONES is a regular in this contest, winning it in 2024 and only narrowly failing to take the prize home again last season. Now 3 lb lower, he looks sure to make another bold bid. The consistent Rebel Tribesman is feared most.

  1. SPIKE JONES
  2. REBEL TRIBESMAN (IRE)
  3. D'JO DELA BARRIERE (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Academy Hurdle
races.verdict:
Gordon Elliott's newcomer QUATRE SAISON gets the tentative nod in a race where the market should prove most informative. Lakeshore and Garrison Gold are also of interest.

  1. QUATRE SAISON (FR)
  2. LAKESHORE (IRE)
  3. GARRISON GOLD (IRE)

races.name: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for REBEL REBA, who offered more at Galway last month and remains low mileage. Western Shores looks the obvious danger on form, whilst Gratitudeforgrace may also get in the money.

  1. REBEL REBA (IRE)
  2. WESTERN SHORES (IRE)
  3. GRATITUDEFORGRACE (FR)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
FUUSLAND is going the right way and looks on a workable mark for his handicap bow. He gets the nod. Live To Laugh and Well Bud head the list of dangers.

  1. FUUSLAND (IRE)
  2. LIVE TO LAUGH (IRE)
  3. WELL BUD (IRE)

races.name: Irish National Hunt Chase CLG Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
A multiple winner over hurdles, GLEN KILN made a positive start over the larger obstacles here last month and gets the nod in what looks a cracking contest. Smart hurdlers Ballyfad and Storm Heart are feared most.

  1. GLEN KILN (IRE)
  2. BALLYFAD (IRE)
  3. STORM HEART (FR)

races.name: Michael O'Sullivan & Lorna Brooke Ireland V Britain (Q.R.) Challenge Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
URBS INTACTA MANET is going the right way in this sphere and looks to have been found a good opportunity to open his account here. A Year Older may provide the chief threat.

  1. URBS INTACTA MANET (IRE)
  2. A YEAR OLDER (IRE)
  3. KILKEE BAY (IRE)

races.name: INHSC Supporting Point-To-Points Hunters Chase
races.verdict:
MY LIFE BE LIKE made the frame in a strong hunter chase on Boxing Day last year and that looks the piece of form to concentrate on. Everest The Brave is unexposed and rates a big danger, while Hearts And Spades can't be ignored.

  1. MY LIFE BE LIKE (IRE)
  2. EVEREST THE BRAVE (IRE)
  3. HEARTS AND SPADES (FR)

races.name: John Thomas McNamara Series (Q.R.) Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TUCKMILL is still well handicapped on old form and can follow up from last time despite a 10 lb rise in the weights. Cahirdown Boy can go well kept to this sphere, while Boola Times can bounce back to form in more favourable conditions.

  1. TUCKMILL (IRE)
  2. CAHIRDOWN BOY (IRE)
  3. BOOLA TIMES (IRE)

races.name: Fairyhouse Christmas Party December 12th Point-To-Point Flat Race
races.verdict:
This can go to BELLAHILL, who made an encouraging start under Rules at Kilbeggan during the summer and he should have learnt plenty from that. Point winners Chanson Du Jury and Heron Hill are the likeliest dangers.

  1. BELLAHILL
  2. CHANSON DU JURY (IRE)
  3. HERON HILL (IRE)
